New Food Innovation · Engineering evidence

What retrieval gets right.

A reproducible comparison of semantic search, BM25, hybrid retrieval, follow-up context and a local cross-encoder.

Preliminary open-literature pilot. 48 AI-authored questions over 12 public abstracts; 24 development and 24 held-out questions, split by source paper. Each split includes six scripted follow-ups. Labels await expert review. Scores measure document retrieval, not answer accuracy, hallucination rate, or production performance.

ConfigurationSource found @3MRR @3nDCG @3p95, local

Source found: labeled paper appears in the top three. MRR rewards finding it nearer the top. nDCG measures ranking quality. Timings exclude model loading and indexing. Exact cosine and BM25 run in memory through the production search code; the production service uses pgvector and PostgreSQL full-text search.

Answer quality

Human-reviewed faithfulness, context precision, answer relevance and hallucination scores are pending. The repository includes answer-review packets, a local-model judge and a fail-closed human-review gate. Missing reviews do not count as passing.
